title: The 15-Minute Subscription Audit
hook_text: YOUR PHONE IS HIDING A $1,800 MISTAKE

beats.say: A $15 a month subscription for 10 years bleeds $1,800 from your checking account.
beats.visual: Macro shot of a smartphone lying face down on a dark wooden table in dim light.

beats.say: Most people pay for at least three services they haven't opened in six months.
beats.visual: A pair of hands holding a dark phone, scrolling past a blurred app menu.

beats.say: Here's the 15 minute fix to stop the leak right now.
beats.visual: Close-up of a silver pen resting on a blank white notepad under a warm desk lamp.

beats.say: Step one. Open your banking app and tap on your recurring monthly payments list.
beats.visual: Overhead view of a coffee cup next to a closed minimalist laptop.

beats.say: Step two. Highlight every charge you haven't used in the last 30 days.
beats.visual: A hand sliding a sleek metal card across a dark marble countertop.

beats.say: Step three. Cancel them immediately through the provider settings, not your browser.
beats.visual: A finger pressing the power button on the side of a smartphone.

beats.say: But here's the part nobody mentions about these tiny monthly bills.
beats.visual: Low angle shot of a concrete ceiling in a modern apartment with soft window shadows.

beats.say: Companies rely on your silence to raise prices by 10% every single year.
beats.visual: A single house key resting on a wooden entryway table.

beats.say: Redirect that recovered cash straight into an index fund at 8% a year.
beats.visual: A ceramic mug being lifted off a glass surface, leaving a faint condensation ring.

beats.say: Small automated habits build real wealth over time without you noticing the sacrifice.
beats.visual: Sunlight casting long window blinds shadows across an empty hardwood floor.
A closed front door with a brass handle in evening shadows.

caption: Stop letting forgotten apps drain your paycheck. Follow for the money rules school never taught you. #money #personalfinance #budgeting #wealthbuilding
description: A quick 15-minute subscription audit stops hidden monthly leaks and frees up cash for investing. Learn the simple 3-step fix to take back control.
first_comment: What's the most expensive subscription you forgot you had?
